{{Quote|First, you lose this system, and ''Grievous'' comes in and destroys my entire stronghold, leaving me here to just ''rummage'' through the leftovers of my once-great empire.|Hondo Ohnaka, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Revival" />}}
An '''invasion of Florrum''' occurred on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The battle was fought between [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]], backed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Because Ohnaka had held [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] for ransom, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched an assault on [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Ohnaka's pirate outpost]]. Catching the pirates by surprise with his attack, Grievous entered the outpost and met Ohnaka in person. Grievous then opened a holo-communication channel through which Count Dooku spoke with Ohnaka. The Count, who had neither forgotten nor forgiven Ohnaka's questionable hospitality during their first encounter, announced that he was taking control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and planned to dismantle Ohnaka's arsenal.

When Ohnaka protested, he was swiftly incarcerated. [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]], who was returning from recapturing [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], was surprised upon seeing [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the outpost. Tano convinced her captors that the Jedi and pirates needed to join forces against the invaders. When they agreed, the Jedi and pirates proceeded to free Ohnaka and the captured pirate forces. Grievous, however, learned of their presence and ordered [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] to destroy the outpost. After a chase through the trenches of a dried geyser field and a brief confrontation with Grievous, the Jedi and pirate forces escaped Florrum aboard [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].

==Prelude==
[[File:CrucibleAttacked-BFR.png|thumb|left|250px|Hondo's ship ''Acushnet'' attacks the ''Crucible'']]
{{Quote|This planet is now under Separatist control!''"<br />"''Ah ha... and, what do you suppose that means?''"<br />"''It means you have a new master, pirate scum.|General Grievous and Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="ANB" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] had hijacked a [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]], the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], in an attempt to steal lightsaber crystals. They were repulsed from the ship, but they captured [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as they escaped.<ref name="ATOS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] on the ''Crucible'',<ref name="BFR" /> [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]],<ref name="TG">{{TCW|The Gathering (episode)}}</ref> rescued Tano from the pirates by disguising themselves as [[Circus/Legends|circus]] performers within [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]],<ref name="BFR" /> but the pirates began chasing them once they figured out their plan. When they reached the ''Crucible'', they took off, but the ship's engines were shot by a pirate's [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]]. The ''Crucible'' crashed and Tano and the younglings were recaptured by the gang. When the pirate captors returned to the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|outpost]], they spotted a [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] massing an invasion against the base. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], had first seized control of the [[Florrum system/Legends|Florrum system]],<ref name="ANB" /> which the Republic had held up until that point,<ref name="Revival" /> before leading an attack on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] itself. Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="ANB" /> having been previously captured and held for ransom by the Ohnaka Gang,<ref name="DC">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> ordered Grievous to launch an assault on Florrum in retribution for Ohnaka's actions.<ref name="ANB" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|What the? Droids? It's an invasion.|Gwarm|<ref name="ANB" />}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:GrievousTossesHondo-ANB.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous manhandling Ohnaka]]</div>
With the Jedi and the pirate joined forces together, Tano devised a plan to use [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and the pirate's tank to divert the droids' attention for a bit while they sneaked into the pirate base and freed Hondo Ohnaka from the captivity. After they rescued Ohnaka, they freed the rest of the pirate forces, but [[OOM-87/Legends|one droid]] managed to alert Grievous to their presence. Grievous decided to cut the problem short by having the prison section leveled by his tanks, but the Jedi and the pirates managed to break out, fight through the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, and flee the outpost. Ohnaka, his pirates, and [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]] piloted [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bikes]], while Tano, [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], R2-D2 and the other [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] piloted a WLO-5 speeder tank. Grievous then pursued them in his [[Combat speeder/Legends|combat speeder]] with three [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] piloting [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] for support. During the chase, the Jedi and pirates were separated; Ohnaka, Katooni and pirates were able to reach [[Hondo's secret ship vault/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's secret starship vault]], while Tano's team were still pursued by Grievous. Ohnaka was going to fly away from the battle at first, but Katooni succeeded in appealing to his sense of honor.<ref name="ANB" />

In the meantime, Grievous prepared to board the Jedi's speeder tank, which forced R2-D2 to execute some risky maneuvers in an attempt to shake him off. However, this move crashed the tank, causing both Grievous and the Jedi to fall from the vehicle. The stunned Jedi were recovering just as Grievous moved in for the kill<ref name="ANB" /> when [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]<ref name="ANBEpisodeGuide" /> arrived to help the Jedi. Tano sent her youngling charges to the craft and engaged Grievous in combat to cover their escape. She then barely escaped onto the ship on her own, and before Ohnaka had a chance to properly repay Grievous for his cordiality, a squad of AATs fired at them and forced them to escape.<ref name="ANB" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Second_Battle_of_Florrum_aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|Ohnaka's destroyed outpost]]
With the last of Ohnaka's pirates and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] retreated from Florrum, the planet was fully conquered by the Separatists. The pirates and the Jedi met with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="ANB" /> who had been [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|defeated by Grievous]]<ref name="BFR" /> and rescued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] rescue team. Aboard Kenobi's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Jedi cruiser]], Ohnaka boldly attempted to weasel his way out of trouble by claiming the various expenses he incurred saving the younglings, so Kenobi decided to leave it at that. Ohnaka then departed and the younglings were invited by Kenobi to form a wheel with their ignited lightsabers.<ref name="ANB" />

Later during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ohnaka returned to his destroyed base with the remaining of his pirates.<ref name="Revival" /><ref name="ANBEpisodeGuide" /> The resurfaced<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] launched an [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|attack]] on Ohnaka's destroyed outpost with his renegades pirates. However, they were repelled from the outpost and eventually defeated with Kenobi's help, forcing the brothers to retreat.<ref name="Revival" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] in "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]"<ref name="Revival" /> then, [[StarWars.com]]'s episode guide wrote that "[[A Necessary Bond]]" answers what exactly happened to Hondo Ohnaka's base, which was seen destroyed in "Revival," the season opener. Originally, "Revival" was planned to air later in the season, in proper chronological order, but it was moved to the start in order to better showcase the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] storyline. In "Revival," Ohnaka describes his base being overrun by General Grievous."<ref name="ANBEpisodeGuide" />
